name: חֵפֶר
gloss: Hepher, possibly a digging or pit
summary: The census names Hepher as ancestor of the Hepherite clan and father of Zelophehad. Chronicles also names a son of Naarah and a Mecherathite among David’s warriors.
note: Joshua 12:17 lists a town of the same name. The proposed link with digging rests on the form of the name.
